question: The longest diagonal of a cube is 6sqrt3 cm. Find the total surface area of the cube.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diagonal of a **cube** = a√3, where 'a' is the **side**.

Given: a√3 = 6√3 ⇒ a = 6 cm.

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** = 6a².

TSA = 6 × 6² = 6 × 36 = 216 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Longest diagonal of the **cube** (d) = 6√3 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Diagonal of a cube = √3 × **Side**

**Total Surface Area** of a cube = 6 × (**Side**)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a2d65533b73186204d672d74000cbd038f23892e269894d32271d286c32a8ef.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **side** of the cube be 'a'.

⇒ Longest diagonal = a√3

⇒ 6√3 = a√3

⇒ a = 6 cm

⇒ **Total Surface Area** = 6 × a²

⇒ TSA = 6 × (6)²

⇒ TSA = 6 × 36

⇒ TSA = 216 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 216 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cube

The amount of space occupied by the cube is given by V = a³, where 'a' is the side length.

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four vertical faces of the cube is LSA = 4a².

Face Diagonal

The diagonal of any single square face of a cube is given by df = a√2.</p
